name: iep-cat-robots
text:
# ==========================================================
# ROBOTS.TXT - KOHA IEP (2026)
# ==========================================================

# --- BLOQUE 1: BLOQUEO TOTAL DE IA Y SCRAPERS ---
# Evitamos que usen el catálogo para entrenar modelos sin permiso
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: anthropic-ai
User-agent: Omgilibot
User-agent: Omgili
User-agent: FacebookBot
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: Diffbot
User-agent: ImagesiftBot 
User-agent: YouBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: Applebot
User-agent: XBot
User-agent: TwitterBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

# --- BLOQUE 2: BUSCADORES GENERALES (GOOGLE, BING, ETC) ---
User-agent: *
# Forzamos a los buscadores a ir despacio para no saturar Perl/Plack
Crawl-delay: 20

# Bloqueo de rutas críticas de Koha que consumen mucha CPU/RAM
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-retrieval.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-showmarc.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-detailprint.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-export.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-report.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-account.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-user.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-basket.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-shelves.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-tags.pl

# Si usas URLs amigables (RewriteRules), añade estas:
Disallow: /opac-search.pl
Disallow: /opac-detail.pl?*
Disallow: /search?*

# --- BLOQUE 3: PERMITIR CONTENIDO ESTÁTICO ---
Allow: /opac-tmpl/
Allow: /api/v1/
